5.9.3.2 Rte_GetMirror
[SWS_Rte_91166] Definition of callback function Rte_GetMirror_<b>_<d> ⌈
Service Name
Rte_GetMirror_<b>_<d>
Syntax
Std_ReturnType Rte_GetMirror_<b>_<d> (
void* NVMBuffer
)
Service ID [hex]
0x9c
▽
△
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Non Reentrant
Parameters (in)
None
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
NVMBuffer
destination buffer pointer
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: the copy is successful.
E_NOT_OK: the copy could not be performed.
Description
The Rte_GetMirror API copies the values of the VariableDataPrototypes contained in a NvBlock
Descriptor to a specified NVM internal buffer.
In the prototype, <b> is the SwComponentPrototype’s name of the
NvBlockSwComponentType and <d> is the NvBlockDescriptor name.
Available via
Rte_<NvBlockSwComponentType>.h
⌋
Rte_GetMirror warranties the consistency of the VariableDataPrototypes contained in a NvBlockSwComponentType, when their values are written to the NVRAM
device by the NVM.
[SWS_Rte_07316]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00178
⌈An Rte_GetMirror API shall be created for each instance of a NvBlockDescriptor.⌋
The Rte_GetMirror API copies the values of the VariableDataPrototypes contained in a NvBlockDescriptor to a specified NVM internal buffer.
[SWS_Rte_07317]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00177
⌈The Rte_GetMirror API shall copy the NvBlockDescriptor’s ramBlock to the
specified buffer, according to the NvBlockDescriptor’s NvBlockDataMapping.⌋
The RTE is responsible for ensuring the data consistency, see section 4.2.6 In particular for the NvBlockDescriptor, the Sender-Receiver ports, the Rte_SetMirror, and Rte_GetMirror may access concurrently the same VariableDataPrototypes.
[SWS_Rte_07350]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00178
⌈The Rte_GetMirror API shall be callable after the Rte is stopped (with Rte_Stop),
and can rely on a running OS.⌋
The NVM module uses the return value of the Rte_GetMirror API to check if the
copy was successful. In case of failure, the NVM may retry later.
